representative_scale.gpu_class: One NVIDIA data-centre GPU, H100/A100/A10 class per brief; actual GPU model unavailable.
representative_scale.scale_selection: Single fixed brief workload; no scale search or doubling.
representative_scale.method: Candidate may run replicas concurrently on same single GPU; physical workload and seeds fixed.

raw_energy_series.reason: Driver samples every 250 steps but retains only mean and final value in JSON. Full-series comparison would need additional instrumentation; no such command published in brief.

timing_scope.ensemble: perf_counter before sequential replica loop through completion and destruction of final context/integrator; includes all Context construction, position and velocity initialization, stepping, synchronized energy queries and cleanup.
excludes: ForceField and System construction before timer
JSON serialization and stdout after timer
timing_scope.replica: Starts after Context/positions/velocities initialization; includes 25000 integration steps and 100 energy queries, excludes context creation and cleanup.
timing_scope.warmup: None separately specified in supplied driver; first-use kernel costs within ensemble timer.
timing_scope.candidate: Use matching ensemble completion timing including creation/initialization/cleanup of all replicas; concurrency launch and synchronization overhead must not be omitted.
timing_scope.upstream_difference: benchmark.py uses adaptive step selection for target seconds with initial steps and initialization before integration timing; not the requested fixed-work score.

scoring_interface.validity: Require all eight seeds and 25000 steps per replica, one GPU and unchanged physical configuration; compare scientific outcomes per benchmark.json.
scoring_interface.tolerance_reason: No published acceptance tolerance or baseline run-to-run energy distribution available.
scoring_interface.published_reference: anchors.json contains contextual fixed-time throughput reference only.

budget_evidence.estimate: About one minute on H100, a few minutes on slower GPUs; CUDA estimate unverified.
budget_evidence.fit: Fixed workload expected to fit default budgets based on brief; actual runtime, package installation duration and MPS setup unmeasured.

repeat_reason: Not specified; no invented statistical repeat rule.
mps_setup_reason: No daemon setup command supplied in brief; MPS availability and permissions require later verification.
intake_execution: No builds, installation checks or simulation workloads run.
